summary: Design governed AI services, assess vendors, and build an enterprise AI operating model. Explore the practical five-day training course.
lede: Enterprise AI enablement gives AI programme leads, enterprise architects, and risk leaders a repeatable way to turn approved initiatives into governed, supportable services. They learn to prioritize use cases and assess vendors, establish prompt and agent controls and service ownership, and track AI performance, risk, and lifecycle decisions.
audienceIntro: AI enablement training is designed for leaders and specialists who must turn approved AI initiatives into governed, supportable enterprise services. It suits professionals who coordinate business demand, architecture, risk, compliance, platform operations, and executive reporting across the AI lifecycle.
audience: Heads of analytics and AI CoEs
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of enterprise digital transformation, technology delivery, data governance, risk management, or AI programme activity. Familiarity with cloud services and business process mapping is useful. No coding or model-training experience is required. Advanced AI architecture and model engineering are introduced at an operational application level rather than a technical engineering level. Bring a current or representative AI use case if available, subject to organizational confidentiality requirements.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
